story.titleZh: 这一“修复”方案本无法拯救F1西班牙大奖赛
story.summaryZh: 针对西班牙大奖赛观感平淡的问题，外界多归咎于马德里赛道缺乏超车机会，但乔恩·诺布尔指出战术变化不足也是被忽视的因素，而所谓的“修复”方案本无法拯救这场比赛。
story.originalTitle: This 'fix' wouldn't have saved F1's Spanish GP
story.summaryEn: The lack of overtaking at the Madring circuit has been blamed for the Spanish Grand Prix's poor spectacle, but another overlooked factor was the lack of strategic variation, meaning track changes alone would not have saved the race.
detailZh: 西班牙大奖赛未能呈现出今年其他一级方程式比赛所提供的那种精彩场面，这不可避免地让人们把焦点放在了马德里赛道缺乏超车机会这一点上。
组合式弯道、护栏收窄点以及缺乏宽阔的重刹车区域——尤其是在5号弯——都使得超越对手变得极其困难。
正如The 比赛（比赛媒体）在周日透露的那样，马德里赛道的主管方已经在计划对三个关键弯角进行改造，以迎接2027年，并期待明年的比赛能呈现出更多看点，这也就不足为奇了。
但导致比赛缺乏精彩对抗的不仅仅是赛道布局，另一个影响比赛走向的因素是战略上的变化也不多。
再无聊的赛道布局，只要轮胎策略被彻底打乱，也能奉献精彩的对决。
如果通往方格旗的最快路线变得不明确，各车队就会采取不同的策略，同时由此产生的速度差也会制造出并轮缠斗的机会。
马德里赛道就出现了那种摩纳哥或索契式的现象：硬胎（在西班牙站是C2配方）足够支撑整场比赛——加斯利就证明了这一点，他一直坚持到倒数第二圈才进行强制配方更换，换掉他起步时使用的轮胎。
周五首次练习后，鉴于观察到的高磨损程度，曾有人半开玩笑地称可能出现六停策略；但随后情况戏剧性地转变为轻松的一停，令人惊讶。
哈斯车手奥康表示，轮胎的表现是导致比赛中没有太多精彩对抗的限制因素之一，因为只要车手不在前车尾流中待太久，就可以毫无顾虑地持续推进。
他说：“问题在于第二节 阶段（节段）轮胎表现得太稳定了，一旦你跟上前车，你就会损失大量抓地力。”
“当我给其他车让蓝旗的时候，我轻松就损失了半秒，甚至十分之七秒。之后抓地力又会恢复，因为这完全和过热有关。”
“一旦过热降下来，你的速度就回来了。所以这就是为什么没有超车。基本上来说，节奏太快了。”
“从你进站的那一刻到最后，简直就是120%的状态。而且因为没出现颗粒化，我们才取得了这样的结果。如果我们周五就有一场比赛，情况会好得多！”
这样的结果不可避免地引发了质疑：如果轮胎配方更偏激进一些，马德里赛道这场大戏会不会更精彩？
一个美好的设想是：如果去掉C2硬胎在耐热性和机械耐磨性上带来的那份从容，西班牙大奖赛本来会更好看。
这意味着，如果被迫使用更软的配方，车手们在轮胎撑不完全程的情况下会面临更大挑战，从而带来更多刺激。
这个想法不错，但遗憾的是，现实很残酷，因为要理解决定一场比赛能否成为策略杰作的种种复杂因素并不容易。
首先，C2 和 C3 在表现和特性上有明显差异，这意味着虽然硬胎适合跑完整场比赛，中性胎的表现却明显差得多，而且更容易出现轮胎起粒的风险。
正如迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里所说：“中性胎简直糟透了。它实际上只在一圈内表现不错，之后就非常糟糕。”
不过，轮胎衰退加剧并不自动意味着进站次数更多。它可能导致（尤其是在超车困难时）更多的轮胎管理和赛车远远偏离节奏，最终呈现的场面就和周日的比赛一样。
此外，马德里赛道有一个重要因素将永远不利于多次进站的比赛，那就是维修区通道的长度。
在那里更换轮胎大约需要25秒——这是本赛季损失时间最大的赛道之一——所以车队总是想尽量减少换胎的必要性。
根据马德里赛道的实际情况，倍耐力认为把配方调软一档——使用C3/C4/C5而不是C2/C3/C4——并不能提升比赛的观赏性。
这是因为，正如倍耐力赛车运动负责人达里奥·马拉富斯基所指出的，从车手们在比赛中短暂使用C3和C4轮胎时苦苦支撑的表现来看，那样做只会把比赛变成一场艰难的轮胎管理大戏。
再加上马德里赛道凭借倾斜的La Monumental弯道以及大量的弯角，成为赛历中对轮胎要求最具挑战性的赛道之一，这也会因高磨损程度而增加安全风险的可能性。
“这将是一场因高磨损而需要两次进站的比赛，”马拉法斯基对The 比赛表示，“从纸面上看，你可以说‘好吧，这必须是一次两次进站的比赛’。”
“但由于交通状况的影响，车手们最终只会像加斯利那样做。”
“把C2作为比赛用胎是个好选择，这让车队在早期安全车出现的情况下仍有可能一次进站完成比赛。如果用C3/C4/C5就太过分了。”
如果再选择更软的轮胎，排位赛也会出现麻烦。实际上，使用C4轮胎的车队在争夺发车位时，仅仅跑一个单圈冲刺，轮胎就因过热而发出尖啸。
C5轮胎很可能会性能断崖式下滑，基本没什么用处。
马拉富斯基补充道："即使用软胎只跑一圈，经过纪念性弯道（La Monumental）之后，后轮过热的问题就已经出现了。如果软胎是C5，也许在排位赛中也会有热衰退的风险。那就得不偿失了。"
现实情况是，一场比赛能呈现多种策略并行的完美组合、还是变成毫无悬念的轻松一停，抑或陷入彻底混乱，三者之间的差距有时并不大。
由于马德里赛道非常平整、抓地力很高，各车队在赛前就清楚，只要能避免轮胎起粒的风险，一停策略就是可行的。
如果不能避免，正如一位工程师所说，比赛就会变成一场混乱、轮胎严重衰退、两停甚至更多次进站的起粒大混战。
虽然后者听起来很刺激，但实际上它同样有风险，会带来一样糟糕的结果：那就是那种进站循环没完没了、整场比赛毫无叙事线索的大奖赛。
马德里赛道一些注定的特点——平整且高抓地力的表面、La Monumental弯角所承受的巨大作用力、以及很长的维修区通道——意味着除非超车机会得到改善，否则很难通过其他手段鼓励更多的进站。
所有人的目光都集中在明年赛道会做出哪些改动上，因为为超车打开大门，也将是提升比赛策略性元素的最佳方式。
detailEn: The failure of the Spanish Grand Prix to produce the kind of spectacle offered by other Formula 1 races this year has inevitably focused on the lack of overtaking opportunities around the Madring circuit.
Combined entries, barrier pinch points and a lack of wide, heavy braking zones - especially at Turn 5 - all contributed to making it extremely difficult to pass a rival.

It is little wonder, as The Race revealed on Sunday, that Madring chiefs are already planning changes to three key corners for 2027 with the expectation that next year's race produces a bit more of a show.
But it was not just the track layout that contributed to a lack of action, as another factor in how things played out was that there was not much strategic variation either.
Even the most boring of track layouts can deliver thrillers if tyre strategy gets blown open.
Make the fastest route to the chequered flag unclear and you get teams taking different approaches, plus the kinds of pace offset that create the circumstances for wheel-to-wheel action.

The Madring delivered one of those Monaco/Sochi-style phenomena where the hard tyre (the C2 compound in Spain) was good enough to last the whole race - as Pierre Gasly proved by waiting until the penultimate lap for his mandatory compound switch to get off what he had started the race with.

After tongue-in-cheek claims after first running on Friday of a potential six-stopper being on the cards, based on the high levels of degradation seen, the transformation into an easy one-stopper was remarkable.

Haas driver Esteban Ocon said the behaviour of the tyres was one of the limiting factors in why there was not much action in the race, because drivers could push on without fear of excessive degradation as long as they did not spend too much time in the dirty air of the car ahead.
"The thing is that it was so consistent, the tyres on the second stint, that as soon as you were following another car, you were losing so much grip," he said.
"When I was doing blue flags to other cars, I was losing half a second, seven tenths easily. And then after it was coming back because it was all about overheating.
"As soon as the overheating was coming down, you had pace again. So that's why there was no overtaking. It was too fast, the pace, basically.
"It was like 120% from as soon as you pitted to the end. And because the graining didn't happen, that's where we ended up. If we had a race on Friday, it would have been much better!"
This outcome has inevitably prompted questions about whether the Madring spectacle would have been more entertaining had the tyre compounds been a bit more on the aggressive side.
It is a nice theory that if you took away the comfort of the thermal and mechanical robustness of the C2 hard tyre the Spanish GP would have been better.
That suggests that, forced onto softer compounds, drivers would have had a more challenging time in having rubber that did not last the whole distance, thereby producing more excitement.
The idea is good, but sadly reality bites when it comes to understanding the complex factors that dictate whether races become strategic masterclasses.

First, there is a notable difference in behaviour and characteristics between the C2 and the C3, which means that, while the hard was good for the whole race, the medium was significantly not as good and much more prone to the risk of graining.
As McLaren's Oscar Piastri said: "The medium tyre was just awful. It was good for literally one lap, but then it was terrible."

Increased degradation does not automatically mean more stops though. It can (especially when overtaking is difficult) lead to more tyre management and cars running well off the pace, and you end up with the same spectacle as we got on Sunday.
Plus, one important element at Madring that will forever speak against multi-stop races is the length of the pitlane.
Swapping tyres there costs around 25 seconds - one of the biggest losses of the season - so teams are always going to try to minimise the need to change tyres.
Based on the evidence from the Madring, Pirelli felt that going a step softer with the compounds - bringing the C3/C4/C5 rather than the C2/C3/C4 - was not a way to improve the spectacle.

That is because, as Pirelli's head of motorsport, Dario Marrafuschi, pointed out, based on the struggles that drivers had with the C3 and C4 in the short stints in which they managed to keep them alive in the race, it would have simply turned the race into a major management drama.

Throw into the mix too that the Madring, thanks to the banked La Monumental and high numbers of corners, is one of the most challenging tracks on the calendar for tyres, then it would also increase the possibility of safety dangers thanks to the high levels of wear.
"It would have been a two-stop race with a high wear," Marrafuschi told The Race. "On paper you can say, 'OK, it must be a two-stopper'.
"But, because of traffic, drivers would just end up doing what Gasly did.
"It was a good choice to have the C2 as a race compound and give teams the possibility to have one-stop in case of an early safety car. The C3/C4/C5 would have been too much."
Going softer would also have caused trouble in qualifying. As it was, the C4 teams took into the fight for grid positions was screaming from overheating doing a single push lap.
The C5 would probably have fallen off a cliff and been pretty useless.

Marrafuschi added: "Even during one lap with the soft, after La Monumental, the overheating of the rear was there. If the soft was a C5, maybe you would run the risk of thermal degradation during qualifying as well. It wouldn't pay the bill."
The reality is that the margins between a race delivering a perfect strategy mix of different approaches, a nailed on easy one-stopper, and complete chaos are sometimes not very much.
With Madrid's track being super-smooth, and offering high grip, teams knew going into the race that if they could avoid the risk of graining, then the one-stop strategy was on.
If not, as one engineer said, then it would instead have turned into a chaotic, heavy-degradation, two-stop-plus graining fest.
While the latter may sound exciting, it actually risks producing something that is equally as bad: one of those grands prix where there is just an endless cycle of stops so the race has no narrative.

Some of the nailed-on elements of Madring - the smooth, high-grip surface, the forces through La Monumental, and the long pitlane - mean that unless overtaking opportunities are improved there is little that can be done to encourage more stops.
All eyes are on what track changes are done next year because opening the door for passes will be the best way to improve the strategy element too.
keyPointsZh: 赛道问题包括组合弯角、护墙收紧的瓶颈点，以及缺乏宽大的重刹车区，尤其是5号弯。
据The 比赛周日披露，马德里赛道管理层已计划在2027年修改三个关键弯角，并期待明年的比赛能有更多观赏性。
本文指出，比赛缺乏精彩场面的另一个原因是比赛中战术变化不多。
keyPointsEn: Madring chiefs are already planning changes to three key corners for 2027, hoping next year's race delivers more of a show
Combined entries, barrier pinch points and a lack of wide, heavy braking zones, especially at Turn 5, made passing extremely difficult
There was not much strategic variation in the race, which was another factor behind the lack of action

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
